_comment: Checkbox indicators for the Windows Triage Decision Tree (Module 3). Each id referenced in family-profiles.json's 'indicators' arrays must exist here -- run the id-integrity check described in README.md after editing either file. The optional 'attack' field is a MITRE ATT&CK technique ID (verified against attack.mitre.org) shown as a badge next to the indicator; omit it rather than guess if a new indicator doesn't map cleanly to one technique.
